title: verbascum cystolithicum
intro: Verbascum cystolithicum, commonly known as the giant mullein or giant velvet plant, is a species of flowering plant in the mullein genus. It is native to the Balkan Peninsula and parts of Eastern Europe. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to soothe sore throats, reduce inflammation, and treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum cystolithicum include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
